author: fwyzard
body:
Update CUDA to version 13.5.0:
  - update the redistributable NVIDIA driver libraries to version 620.70.06, from the R620 branch that goes with CUDA 13.5.
  - the CUDA 13.5 installer aborts if it cannot add the Nsight desktop menu entries under the home directory: extract it, drop the entries from the manifests, and run it directly.

Update cuDNN to version 9.28.1.4:
  - cuDNN 9.28 adds support for CUDA 13.5.
title: Update CUDA to v13.5.0
